verdict.rationale: Conductor is built around managing multiple parallel agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) each in its own workspace/branch/terminal/diff, with collaboration features (reassign, shared links), programmatic/API and MCP management, and cloud workspaces that persist after closing the laptop — directly matching the engineering-lead unified-workspace story, corroborated by hands-on community use. missing for 10: independent verification of team-scale management (many engineers/many sessions) beyond single-user hands-on reports, and unresolved community concerns about GitHub permission scope that add friction to lead-level rollout.
